title: Fixed Pipeline with Code-Based Seam Check
description: A three-stage pipeline (extract, draft, polish) runs with model calls. A check_times function in code verifies every extracted day and time appears in the final text. If any are missing, it returns the draft with the problem attached.
source: draft: omp free model + edit: codex

steps.description: The check_times function splits the facts string by lines. It parses each pipe-separated row for name, day, time. It checks that 'day at time' appears in the final text, returning a list of missing facts.
Lines 6-8 extract the day and time from each fact row and check if the formatted string 'day at time' is present in the polished text.
The digest_pipeline function runs three model calls in sequence: EXTRACT, DRAFT, POLISH, printing each intermediate result.
Line 12 calls the model with the EXTRACT prompt on the messages, line 13 prints the extracted facts.

steps.question: What does the POLISH stage do in the example output that breaks a fact?
steps.answer: changes Thursday to Friday for the Chess club event

steps.description: After polish, check_times runs on the facts and final text. If missing facts are found, it prints the problem and returns the draft instead of the final, with the missing list attached.
The pipeline runs: extract finds 3 events, and draft includes all correctly. Polish changes Thursday to Friday, and the check catches it. The result returns the draft with 3 model calls.
